app.tray.tooltip_hold: Omvix Hub — Battery Hold active (will not charge)
app.tray.tooltip_inhibit: Omvix Hub — Battery Inhibit active (limit enabled)
app.close_to_tray_notice: Omvix Hub is still running in the system tray.
app.non_admin_banner: Running without Administrator privileges. Live telemetry & display Hz work; HP WMI BIOS writes (fans, thermal, 0x2B battery limit, RGB, MUX) require Administrator.
app.worker_dead_warning: Background monitor thread stopped! Restoring BIOS Auto fans — please restart Omvix Hub.
home.title: Quick Control Cockpit
board.experimental_desc: This board ID is not yet in the verified list. BIOS WMI writes are paused until you approve Experimental Mode after checking read-only probes.
board.probe_summary: Read-only WMI probe summary: {ok} / {total} commands responded OK.
monitor.title: System Monitor
monitor.ec_note: Fast sensors (CPU/GPU/RAM/Power) update at selected rate; BIOS fans & battery safely cap at 1.0s.
monitor.cpu_temp_pawnio_hint: Exact CPU die °C under Win11 HVCI requires signed PawnIO + IntelMSR.bin (no OGH needed). EC 0x23 shows chassis temp.
monitor.thermal_guard_active: THERMAL GUARD: Emergency Max Fan Active
monitor.no_throttle_tooltip: Throttle status: None. GPU is running without thermal or power clock throttling.
monitor.throttle_active_tooltip: GPU is currently reducing clocks due to: {reason}.
monitor.gpu_pstate_tooltip: Current NVIDIA performance power state (P0 = full performance, P8 = idle low power).
monitor.gpu_sleeping_tooltip: Discrete GPU is asleep in D3 power-saving state. NVML polling is paused so Omvix Hub does not wake the GPU.
fan.hysteresis_desc: Deadband while cooling: keeps current fan speed until temperature drops by at least this many °C below its peak, preventing rapid RPM hunting.
fan.keep_alive_desc: Refreshes HP BIOS user-defined fan level every 45s because HP firmware automatically reverts Manual/Curve control to BIOS Auto after ~120s of silence.
fan.no_cpu_sensor_notice: No direct CPU die sensor (PawnIO not installed): curve safely uses GPU + conservative Chassis/Power estimate + {temp}°C/<1800 RPM Emergency Guard.
fan.curve_drag_hint: Drag any of the 8 points directly on the chart to adjust temperature & speed. Linear interpolation runs smoothly between points.
fan.conflict_service_warning: HP OGH / OMEN or Intel XTU background services are running and may override fan curves or thermal profiles.
fan.guard_desc: Engages Emergency Max Fan only when CPU temperature stays at or above the threshold continuously for at least the sustain duration (or if fans stall under load), retrying up to 3 times with Auto fallback.
battery.preset_desktop_desc: Stop 60% / Start 55% - Best when mostly plugged in
battery.preset_balanced_desc: Stop 80% / Start 75% - Ideal daily battery health
battery.no_custom_profiles: No custom battery profiles saved yet.
battery.travel_mode_desc: Temporarily allows charging to 100% once, then restores your charge limit when full or unplugged.
battery.one_time_active: Travel charge active - will revert after reaching 100% or unplugging.
battery.hold_when_shutdown: Keep charge limit after closing Omvix Hub / shutdown
battery.hold_when_shutdown_desc: On (default): leaves Hold protection (0x0300) active when closed, sleeping, or shut down so battery stays limited. Off: restores normal charging (0x2B Auto) when quitting.
battery.service_title: Background Battery Service (Auto Sleep & Shutdown Protection)
battery.service_desc: Optional native Windows service running in the background even when Omvix Hub GUI is closed. Applies Inhibit while running and Hold (0x0300) automatically on Sleep/Shutdown.
battery.service_uninstall_confirm_desc: Stops & deletes OmvixBatteryService, restores normal 0x2B Auto charging, and deletes C:\Program Files\OmvixHub & C:\ProgramData\OmvixHub completely.
battery.service_active_sync_note: Background service is active: thresholds & shutdown mode sync automatically to the service.
battery.service_recommended_note: Tip: Install OmvixBatteryService below so shutdown/sleep Hold protection triggers reliably from Windows PRESHUTDOWN even if Modern Standby skips app hooks.
battery.recovery_title: Battery Mode Recovery (if app folder is deleted manually)
battery.recovery_desc: Firmware 0x2B Hold/Inhibit persists in BIOS/EC. To restore 100% charging without the GUI, run an Administrator terminal command or load BIOS Setup -> Restore Defaults:
battery.conflict_service_warning: External `hp-charge-limit-rs` service is running. Background auto-writes are paused to avoid conflicts; click Apply to override manually.
lighting.unsupported: Keyboard RGB control is not exposed by this firmware.
gpu.reboot_required: A system restart is required to apply the MUX switch change.
gpu.bitlocker_warning: Warning: Switching to Discrete mode can trigger a BitLocker recovery key prompt on boot, alter external monitor outputs, and significantly reduce battery life.
gpu.reboot_prompt: MUX change written to BIOS. Restart Windows to take effect:
tuning.vbs_hvci_warning: VBS / Memory Integrity (HVCI) is active in Windows. Windows hypervisor blocks direct ring-0 MSR undervolting even on unlocked HX processors. WMI/Win32 thermal, fan, boost, and battery controls continue to work normally.
tuning.admin_required_warning: Administrator privileges are required to modify HP WMI BIOS settings.
tuning.power_limit_unknown_board: HP WMI 0x29 power limits are disabled on unrecognized motherboards for safety.
tuning.msr_bridge_unavailable_tooltip: TCC (MSR 0x1A2) and Core Undervolt (MSR 0x150) are disabled until the PawnIO MSR write bridge is implemented (and require Windows VBS/HVCI to be off).
hotkeys.custom_command_hint: Only .exe or .lnk files are allowed. Launched unelevated (Medium integrity) — never as Administrator.
conflicts.title: Background Service Conflicts
conflicts.none_detected: No conflicting HP or charge-limit background services detected.
conflicts.detected_summary: Detected {count} active background service(s) that may override fan, thermal, or battery commands.
logs.title: Diagnostic Logging
diagnostics.title: Hardware & WMI Diagnostics
settings.hide_on_focus_loss: Auto-hide to tray when clicking outside (Compact mode)
settings.import_placeholder: Paste OMVIX1|... code or theme JSON
settings.autostart_admin_note: When enabled as Administrator, copies Omvix Hub into C:\Program Files\OmvixHub and registers an elevated Task Scheduler logon task (zero UAC popup on battery or AC).
settings.installed_copy_outdated: Installed Program Files copy is older than this executable.
settings.pawnio_desc: Downloads & verifies Microsoft WHQL-signed PawnIO driver + IntelMSR.bin module (zero OMEN Gaming Hub dependency, works under Windows 11 VBS/HVCI).
settings.reset_desc: Restores BIOS Auto fans, Balanced mode, 100% normal battery charging (0x2B Auto), Windows default CPU Boost (Aggressive), max native Hz, white keyboard lighting, removes Windows Autostart, and resets app config.
safe_mode.banner_title: Safe Mode Active — Hardware Writes Disabled
safe_mode.reason_cli: Started with --safe flag. No BIOS, fan, battery, or display settings were applied.
safe_mode.reason_shift: Shift key was held during startup. No settings were written to hardware.
safe_mode.reason_crash_loop: Automatic recovery: the last 3 launches exited unexpectedly within 60s after applying hardware settings. Hardware writes are paused.
wizard.title: Omvix Hub Setup Wizard
wizard.step1_desc: Omvix Hub detects your HP laptop motherboard and checks read-only BIOS WMI telemetry automatically.
wizard.step2_desc: Optional: start automatically when signing in to Windows via a protected Program Files copy without UAC popups.
wizard.autostart_toggle: Start Omvix Hub at Windows logon
wizard.step3_desc: Under Windows 11 HVCI, reading exact CPU die temperature requires installing the Microsoft-signed PawnIO driver + IntelMSR module.
wizard.step3_optional_note: Optional — fan curves and safety guards still work via GPU & Chassis sensors if you install PawnIO later in Settings.
wizard.step4_desc: Protect battery lifespan by capping maximum charge (0x2B WMI) even when shut down.
wizard.step4_hold_warning: Note: Shutdown Hold (0x0300) remains active while powered off ('When off: Hold — will not charge' above threshold).
wizard.step5_desc: Review your choices below. Every setting can be adjusted anytime from Omvix Hub.
wizard.safe_mode_tip: Tip: Hold Shift during startup or launch with --safe anytime to open in read-only Safe Mode.
